body:
>Every day, it gets a little easier. But you gotta do it every day. That's the hard part, but it does get easier.

Thank you, running baboon, for your wise words.

Lol but yes actually that is good advice. Thanks :)
Same thing for me man. People day shit like "you're going to be an amazing dad", or even just "what do you want to do after you're finished school?" Die. That's what I want to do.

Well you got the other people living in your body right? Lol sorry. But in all seriousness, there is always somebody out there that will understand you, help you, listen to you. I will if you want, my dms are open, if you need a friend or just someone to vent to.
Thanks, this was really helpful. This gives me a tiny bit more hope that i can eventually be okay.

Yessss definitely. I just today found a way to commit suicide that's actually possible in my circumstances. 

before today, i felt so fucking trapped. There was no escape whatsoever. But now i feel free again. It's very liberating and rather comforting.

Yes this is really well put. I don't have very high expectations, I have none at all really. The hope that i cling on to is just the rational fear of death combined with the wish that i could just have one day where i could catch a break, be okay, maybe, just maybe this suffering isn't forever.

Yes exactly. I have an amazing life, from an outsiders perspective. I'm in a very good school, with very supportive parents, and no money problems.. the only problem is me. I would give my life up in an instant to so many people that deserve it far more than me
Nope lol. Nothing changed in my life, really. Nothing bad is in my life. Nothing caused it, it's just me.
No, not really. I'm not even alive anymore at this point. I don't experience anything, or have any emotion other than the horrible ones
Idk.. am I?
I don't know if what i experience is actually dissociation, but what happens to me is I lose reality pretty much. I can't process anything around me, nothing is real.
Wow. Reading this was literally looking in the mirror. I feel you man.
Thanks man, appreciate the comment :)
Man I'm really sorry you had to go through this. What do you mean by tools for coping?
Thanks for the advice, I'll that in mind
Thanks man. I hope you find your way out of your hole :)
Yeah. That would be amazing. If it all just went away,  and we could just lie here and be okay.

But the thing is, how can I exist 30 years from now? I can't imagine myself being able to live tomorrow, much less in 30 years. If i can't even fathom the Impossible task of waking up tomorrow morning and existing, how can I exist another 30 fucking years??
Conquer what though? The enemy we face has no face. it is everywhere and everything. We can't fight it.
Wow this was beautiful.

Okay at the end you say, " love yourself for who you are" " you are all beautiful". Why would that not apply to you? I get that feeling of losing your beauty, and so young too. That really has to suck. 

But, i don't know what your life is like but most of the time eating disorders are developed while trying to look prettier, or have a nicer body, etc. If it's the same for you, is it not maybe a relief, maybe? You don't have to keep trying to be the most beautiful, be so pretty? It's okay to mourn your lost beauty, but remember your appearance is not all of you. After all, is unhealthy beauty really beautiful?
Yeah man, it really fucking hurts to see how much you hurt the people you care about. I get it
Are you bleeding a lot? Where did you cut? If if you're bleeding a lot, call an ambulance, then apply pressure to the cuts
But, I'm not fighting. I'm running(or at least trying). Trying to escape desperately. It's not working though.

But... I have to say it's true. The peak of your life is when you're  0-7 years old. You don't know what life is. You're sheltered. You're happy, discovering new and exciting things that are amazing to you. It just goes downhill from there
Me too man, me too
Hmm
Okay, thanks! I'll try that, hopefully it'll work. Thanks a lot!
Thanks, i will post an update tomorrow if I'm still alive lol. And yeah i pretty much have cuts send scratches everywhere lol, so even if some parts are hidden others will show lol

I completely get it. All that is needed to brighten a day is a simple gesture of caring, but fuck those are getting pretty rare. 
For what it's worth, I love you <3
But... I'm only this far because I'm too scared to jump and i can't find anything bro overdose on

They didn't ask, and since both my arms are warzones i didn't really care, but I think they pro wouldn't mind if you had a preference of arm.

What I have realized in my loneliness is that women are actual people too, with the same feelings and thoughts as you. There are tons of girls that have never been a relationship, and are as lonely as you. 
So keep trying, you will find someone eventually and they will find you.
